paper_title: Constraints on axions from patchy screening of the cosmic microwave background
suggested_experiment_name: unWISE Blue x Planck patchy screening
notes: Constraint on axion-photon coupling from resonant CMB photon-axion conversion (patchy screening), cross-correlating Planck CMB with unWISE Blue galaxies. Reported bound g_agamma <~ 2e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for 1e-13 eV <~ m_a <~ 1e-12 eV. Encoded as horizontal line at the quoted bound over the stated mass range; Fig.3 shows an actual exclusion curve but only the summary value is given numerically in the text.
